key.name: notify-new-wallpapers
key.description: Send a notification with Like and Dislike when a new wallpaper is set while the window isn't active.

key.name: open-at-login
key.description: Ask the Background portal to start AutoPaper in the background when you log in.

key.name: first-run-done
key.summary: The welcome has been completed or skipped

key.name: history-layout
key.description: Grid or Gallery, as last chosen in History's header bar.

key.name: budget-notified-month
key.summary: The month (YYYY-MM) whose spent budget has been notified

key.name: comfyui-workflow-name
key.summary: The file name of the person's own ComfyUI workflow
key.description: Kept after switching back to AutoPaper's workflow, so the person's own is one choice away.

key.name: comfyui-workflow-text
key.summary: The person's own ComfyUI workflow (API format)
key.description: The engine holds only the workflow in use; this keeps the person's own while AutoPaper's is chosen.

key.name: own-wallpaper
key.summary: The person's own wallpaper, while AutoPaper's is showing
key.description: GNOME's background settings as they were before AutoPaper set one, put back when AutoPaper quits or the person chooses Restore my wallpaper (pausing keeps AutoPaper's showing). Empty while the person's own is showing.

key.name: own-wallpaper-set
key.summary: AutoPaper's picture as it set it
key.description: The Wallpaper portal's copy (~/.config/background) right after AutoPaper last set it: modification time, size and inode. A copy that differs is another app's picture, so the person's own isn't put back over it.

key.name: recent-providers
key.summary: Each provider's last model and server address
key.description: Kept while another provider is chosen ("painting.ComfyUi.address"), so choosing it again brings them back.

key.name: key-problem-notified
key.summary: A missing or rejected key has been notified (cleared when a wallpaper is made)
